factual_errors.text: c = ΔE / (mΔθ) = 15,000 / (5 × 10) = 300 J/kg°C. This is close to the value for brass or copper.
factual_errors.correction: Copper is about 385–390 J/kg°C and brass about 380 J/kg°C. The lesson's own table gives "Copper", "390". A value of 300 J/kg°C is about 25% below these, so calling it 'close to' copper or brass is misleading.
